sponsored.t: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities for fiscal year 2027.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions permanent related to inspections of private passenger automobiles prior to the provision of coverage for physical damage thereto
sponsored.sum: Removes the sunset date of October 1, 2027; makes provisions permanent related to inspections of private passenger automobiles prior to the provision of coverage for physical damage thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the termination of coverage for rehabilitation services solely because of a failure to demonstrate measurable improvement in the applicable condition
sponsored.sum: Provides that a utilization review agent shall not issue an adverse determination denying, reducing, or terminating coverage for medically necessary skilled rehabilitation services solely because the insured or enrollee has failed to demonstrate measurable improvement in the insured's or enrollee's condition.

sponsored.t: Reduces inequities in access to medical procedures
sponsored.sum: Provides that no insurer, health maintenance organization, or any other entity shall, by contract, written policy, or procedure, reduce the payment of a negotiated rate for evaluation and management or procedural services furnished by a participating provider that are otherwise covered services, solely because the provider also billed other health care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to assignment from a decedent's estate to a transferee for value in exchange for cash or other consideration
sponsored.sum: Enacts certain provisions for the assignment from a decedent's estate to a transferee for value in exchange for cash or other consideration; requires certain conditions and a written agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of restitution by registered and unregistered repair shops
sponsored.sum: Establishes that if financial loss has been made and a registrant or unregistered repair shop fails to comply with an order to pay restitution, the commissioner shall, by order, increase the amount of the penalty assessed.

sponsored.t: Relates to addressing non-covered dental services
sponsored.sum: Addresses non-covered dental services by requiring all policies providing coverage of and all contracts for dental services issued to include a disclosure stating that a participating provider may charge their normal fee for services that are not covered; requires a cost estimate to be provided.

sponsored.t: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to seven hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period
sponsored.sum: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to five hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

sponsored.t: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse.

sponsored.t: Clarifies who may sue an insurer for violations related to misrepresentations, misleading statements and incomplete comparisons
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that residents of the state and any policyholder, contract holder, certificate holder, or beneficiary of a policy, contract, or certificate of life, accident and health insurance may sue an insurer for violations related to misrepresentations, misleading statements and incomplete comparisons.

sponsored.t: Establishes a requirement for information related to specialized dental benefit plans
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers and corporations that issue, sell, renew or offer a specialized dental benefits plan policy or contract to report annually on data related to such dental benefits plan policies.

sponsored.t: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated people, to provide incarcerated people opportunities for personal contact with relatives, friends, clergy, volunteers and other persons to promote better institutional adjustment and better community adjustment upon release.

sponsored.t: Includes image-guided biopsies under certain insurance coverage for breast cancer screening
sponsored.sum: Includes image-guided biopsies under mandatory insurance coverage for breast cancer screening.

sponsored.t: Relates to third-party network contracts
sponsored.sum: Allows dental provider networks, certain health and hospital service corporations, and health care plans to enter into contracts with a third party to gain access to services and discounted rates of a provider under a provider network contract.

sponsored.t: Relates to copayment and coinsurance charged for physical and occupational therapy services
sponsored.sum: Provides that any copayment or coinsurance amount charged by an insurer to the insured for services rendered by a physical therapist or an occupational therapist shall not be more than twenty-five percent greater than the copayment or coinsurance amount imposed for an office visit to a licensed primary care physician or osteopath for the same or a similar diagnosed condition.

sponsored.t: Provides that consenting registrants of the adoption information registry may pre-authorize the release of identifying information
sponsored.sum: Provides that consenting registrants of the adoption information registry may pre-authorize the release of identifying information.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services if an insured was covered for such services at the time treatment was initiated; requires insurers to notify a treatment provider when an insured has lost coverage based on termination of the insured's employment.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of financial services publish a report on long-term care insurance rates
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of financial services publish a report on long-term care insurance rates including historical rates and the dates and amounts of any rate changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to utilization review program standards and pre-authorization for certain health care services
sponsored.sum: Relates to utilization review program standards; requires use of evidence-based and peer reviewed clinical review criteria; relates to prescription drug formulary changes and pre-authorization for certain health care services.

sponsored.t: Requires the superintendent of financial services to conduct a review of mandated benefits and their impact on insurance premiums and to conduct a cost analysis of legislation mandating new insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of financial services to conduct a review of mandated benefits in effect as of December 31, 2025 and their impact on insurance premiums and to conduct a cost analysis of legislation mandating new insurance benefits to examine the impact on insurance premiums prior to the adoption of such legislation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time period for submitting reports regarding the valuation manual and makes provisions relating to such valuation manual permanent
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time period for submitting reports regarding the valuation manual; makes provisions relating to such valuation manual permanent.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of any children's product, upholstered furniture or mattress that contains textile fiberglass
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of any children's product, upholstered furniture or mattress that contains textile fiberglass; prohibits any custom upholsterer from repairing, reupholstering, recovering, restoring or renewing upholstered furniture or reupholstered furniture using a replacement component that contains textile fiberglass, fibrous glass or glass wool.

sponsored.t: Relates to digital representations in real estate listings
sponsored.sum: Designates materially misleading digital representations in real estate listings as an unfair, deceptive or abusive act or false advertising; provides that a licensed real estate broker or salesperson shall be subject to suspension or revocation of their license for a violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Terminate Excessive Cross-state Actuarial Subsidization (TEXAS) Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Terminate Excessive Cross-state Actuarial Subsidization (TEXAS) Act" which requires life insurance companies to take state specific population health information into account as a factor; requires the superintendent of financial services to develop a standard weight to be given to state specific population health information in rate-setting.

sponsored.t: Prohibits charging a fee to obtain a certified copy or certified transcript of birth in certain situations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits charging a fee to obtain a certified copy or certified transcript of birth when the department of corrections and community supervision or a local correctional facility requests such for an individual under community supervision in connection with such individual's ongoing supervision in the community.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence for utilization review
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence by insurers and clinical peer reviewers for utilization review; establishes additional notice requirements for adverse determinations.

sponsored.t: Indexes fixed amounts and clarifies compliance for life insurance and annuity businesses; repealer
sponsored.sum: Indexes fixed dollar amounts in the statute to inflation, authorizes changes to compensation plans, removes obsolete language, and removes unnecessary filing requirements for certain life insurance and annuity businesses.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of children's products, mattresses and upholstered furniture containing fiberglass unless they contain a prominent label
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of children's products, mattresses and upholstered furniture containing fiberglass unless they contain a prominent label; defines children's product; prohibits custom upholsterers from repairing or restoring any children's product, mattress or furniture with parts that contain fiberglass; provides remedies for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires the development and implementation of a tattoo policy by law enforcement agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services, the superintendent of the division of state police, and the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision and the person in charge of every state law enforcement agency to adopt and implement a tattoo policy for all members of such law enforcement agency who are designated as police officers, peace officers and applicants for employment in such positions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the formation of mutual holding companies by certain domestic mutual property/casualty insurers and the reorganization in connection therewith of a domestic mutual property/casualty insurer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the formation of mutual holding companies by certain domestic mutual property/casualty insurers and the reorganization in connection therewith of a domestic mutual property/casualty insurer into a domestic stock property/casualty insurer.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial responsibility requirements for transportation network companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to financial responsibility requirements for transportation network companies in relation to uninsured motorists coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to loss prevention programs
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain provisions relating to rebating and discrimination regarding insurance contracts shall not prohibit any insurer from providing loss mitigation or loss control programs at no cost or a reduced cost to policyholders.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions relating to the New York compensation insurance rating board's authorization to make filings with the department of financial services permanent
sponsored.sum: Makes provisions relating to the New York compensation insurance rating board's authorization to make filings with the department of financial services permanent.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York property rehabilitation protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York property rehabilitation protection act" to provide protection against the use of assignment of benefit agreements by rehabilitation contractors in a fraudulent manner.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fraudulent claims reduction and unlawful deception act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fraudulent claims reduction and unlawful deception act" or "FRAUD act"; establishes the crimes of staging a construction site accident for insurance fraud and auto insurance fraud involving staged collisions and fabricated claims; provides for enhanced penalties and enforcement for construction site and auto claims fraud.

sponsored.t: Establishes a uniform effective date for health insurance benefit mandates
sponsored.sum: Establishes a uniform effective date for health insurance benefit mandates by requiring that every law that adds provisions to or amends provisions of sections 3216, 3221, and 4303 of the insurance law requiring a policy of health insurance to provide coverage for a new health care service, treatment, or benefit, or that otherwise mandates coverage under such policy shall take effect no earlier than the first of January next succeeding the date on which it shall have become a law and shall apply to policies and contracts issued, renewed, modified, altered or amended on or after such effective date.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for continuous blood glucose monitors for all children
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for continuous blood glucose monitors for all children; requires coverage for glucose monitoring devices for all sugar disorders.

sponsored.t: Requires school buses to have windows made from bulletproof or ballistic glass
sponsored.sum: Requires school buses to have windows made from bulletproof or ballistic glass; requires the commissioner of motor vehicles and the commissioner of transportation to establish minimum standards and requirements for bulletproof or ballistic glass used.

sponsored.t: Authorizes gambling on professional sporting events and athletic events sponsored by universities or colleges
sponsored.sum: Authorizes gambling on professional sporting events and athletic events sponsored by universities or colleges at betting facilities located at thoroughbred and harness racetracks operating in this state, in simulcast theaters operated by off-track betting corporations and in any constitutionally authorized casino facility; provides that the proceeds of such gambling be applied exclusively to or in aid or support of education.

sponsored.t: Relates to orders of conservation for domestic insurers
sponsored.sum: Relates to orders of conservation for domestic insurers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administrative supervision of insurers deemed to be in a hazardous financial condition
sponsored.sum: Relates to the administrative supervision of insurers deemed to be in a hazardous financial condition.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports.

sponsored.t: Relates to high deductible health plans and health savings accounts; relates to the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2025
sponsored.sum: Relates to cost sharing requirements for high deductible health plans and health savings accounts; relates to the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to the kinds of insurance with respect to which a rental vehicle company or peer-to-peer car sharing program administrator may act as an agent for an authorized insurer
sponsored.sum: Provides that a rental vehicle company or peer-to-peer car sharing program administrator may act as an agent for an authorized insurer with respect to accident and health insurance that provides coverage to shared vehicle owners, shared vehicle drivers, or a combination thereof, and any other coverage that the superintendent of financial services may approve as meaningful and appropriate in connection with the sharing of a shared vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of rates for certain treatment pursuant to the medical assistance program
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of addiction services and supports and the office of mental health to publish information for calculation of rates paid for certain treatment pursuant to the medical assistance program in a form an manner prescribed by the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports or the commissioner of mental health, as applicable.

sponsored.t: Relates to findings of the state board of parole necessary for discretionary release of incarcerated individuals on parole
sponsored.sum: Provides for findings of the state board of parole necessary for discretionary release of incarcerated individuals on parole.

sponsored.t: Relates to observance of all religious holidays by institutions within the state university and the city university of New York, and includes the Asian Lunar New Year within the definition of such holidays
sponsored.sum: Relates to observance of all religious holidays by institutions within the state university and the city university of New York; includes the Asian Lunar New Year within the definition of such holidays.

sponsored.t: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated assault upon a police officer or peace officer
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of aggravated assault upon a police officer or peace officer when, with intent to cause physical injury to another person whom such person knows or reasonably should know to be a police officer or a peace officer engaged in the course of performing such police officer or peace officer's official duties and when aided by two or more other persons actually present at an assembly in a public place, as such term is defined in subdivision one of section 240.00 of this part, such person causes physical injury to such police officer or peace officer.

sponsored.t: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi
sponsored.sum: Directs the Queens county board of elections to provide language assistance in Bengali, Punjabi and Hindi.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the division of criminal justice services from disclosing pending adjournment in contemplation of dismissals on civil records of arrests and prosecutions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the division of criminal justice services from disclosing pending orders of adjournment in contemplation of dismissal on civil records of arrests and prosecutions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes superintendent of financial services to conduct a study and make recommendations on title insurance premium rates in New York state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the superintendent of financial services to conduct a study and make recommendations on title insurance premium rates in NYS.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission to end mass incarceration and to prevent violence
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission to end mass incarceration and to prevent violence; provides such commission shall investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning how to reduce the New York prison population, incidences of violent crime in New York state, and other various topics related to the criminal justice system.

sponsored.t: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board
sponsored.sum: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program for two years without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting voting rates for parole commissioners
sponsored.sum: Requires that annual reports include the voting rates for parole commissioners for persons appearing before them for release.

sponsored.t: Requires counties to maintain a confidential registry of people of all ages with disabilities for disaster preparedness
sponsored.sum: Requires counties to maintain a confidential registry of people of all ages with disabilities for the purpose of evacuating and sheltering such persons during disasters.

sponsored.t: Relates to assault in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to assault in the third degree by a person against an operator, driver or passenger on a bus, taxicab, aerial tramway, subway or other motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to safe staffing for public employees of institutional settings
sponsored.sum: Relates to safe staffing for public employees of institutional settings by setting maximum overtime levels.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain recreational contests in establishments with licenses to sell alcoholic beverages for consumption on premise
sponsored.sum: Allows any person who holds a license to sell alcoholic beverages for consumption on premises to allow players to engage in certain recreational contests.

sponsored.t: Provides for limitations on investments of public pension funds and state contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides for limitations on investments of public pension funds and state contracts; prohibits the investment of the available monies of the common retirement fund in any stocks, securities, equities, assets or other obligations of any corporation or company, or any subsidiary, affiliate or parent of any corporation or company, engaged in the boycott of Israel, including Iran-restricted companies and Sudan-restricted companies; prohibits any firm, partnership or corporation that boycotts Israel, that is an Iran-restricted company or that is a Sudan-restricted company from contracting with the state.

sponsored.t: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board
sponsored.sum: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board.

sponsored.t: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; allows the judge or justice presiding over a proceeding to exercise discretion to prohibit or limit filming or photographing of particular participants; defines terms; provides limitations on audio-visual coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to persons authorized to visit inmate-patient facilities of the department of mental hygiene
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the governor and lieutenant-governor, commissioner of general services, secretary of state, comptroller, attorney general, and members of the legislature, provided that such request does not impact upon the department's ability to manage its facilities as determined by the director of the facility, to visit any facility designated by the commissioner of mental health for care and treatment.

sponsored.t: Discontinues certain real property tax exemptions for real property used for major league sports teams
sponsored.sum: Discontinues the real property tax exemption for certain real property that is used for home games for certain professional sports teams in New York city beginning with the 2026 assessment roll.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to encourage, aid, and facilitate clinical research into the use of ibogaine in drug treatment
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to encourage, aid, and facilitate clinical research into the use of ibogaine in drug treatment for heroin, methamphetamine and cocaine addiction.

sponsored.t: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences
sponsored.sum: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences; requires board of inspectors to deliver and help complete applications for absentee ballots to residents of such facilities.

sponsored.t: Provides that absentee ballots for all elections shall be made available in Braille, upon request of a blind or visually impaired voter
sponsored.sum: Provides that absentee ballots for all elections shall be made available in Braille and large print, upon request of a blind or visually impaired voter no less than 30 days prior to each election day.

sponsored.t: Relates to credits for charges in which services were not supplied
sponsored.sum: Relates to credits for charges in which services were not supplied; requires the city of New York to make certain that there are no charges being levied for services which were not supplied to a covered entity; requires accounts to be credited for services not provided.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot project for the placement of incarcerated individuals close to home
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot project for placement of incarcerated individuals close to home; provides that such project would house incarcerated individuals who are parents of minor children in the correctional facility located in closest proximity to the primary place of residence of any such incarcerated individual's minor child or children.

sponsored.t: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in facilities or discrete units within facilities that provide long term nursing or medical services.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification of termination of group health insurance
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to provide certificate holders with at least thirty days prior written notice of termination of group health insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for certain durable medical equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for certain durable medical equipment equal to fifty percent of the cost to purchase and install durable medical equipment in a residence.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

sponsored.t: Relates to on duty auxiliary police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to an increase in punishment for certain actions against on-duty auxiliary police officers such as criminally negligent homicide, assault or menacing of such officer.

sponsored.t: Directs the state insurance fund to offer title insurance and authorizes the superintendent of financial services to implement such program
sponsored.sum: Directs the state insurance fund to offer title insurance; authorizes the superintendent of financial services to implement such program.

sponsored.t: Requires municipal employees to attempt to identify and notify the owners of a deceased dog or cat recovered on public roads
sponsored.sum: Requires municipal officials to attempt to identify and notify the owners of a deceased dog or cat recovered on public roads by such municipal employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adjudication of parking infractions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the adjudication of parking infractions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits lenders from blocking access to funds from a credit line mortgage
sponsored.sum: Prohibits lenders from blocking access to funds from a credit line mortgage.

sponsored.t: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York; specifies who shall appoint each member.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "tick borne illness treatment and education act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "tick borne illness treatment and education act"; requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens.

sponsored.t: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods
sponsored.sum: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods; establishes this shall not apply to vehicles, vessels, or aircrafts that are used by any person as a common carrier in the transaction of business as such common carrier.

sponsored.t: Requires public schools in N.Y. city to offer food options
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools in any city with a population over one million that have students practicing a religious faith with specific dietary restrictions to offer food options which meet such dietary restrictions upon the students' request.

sponsored.t: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Establishes the interstate insurance product regulation compact to regulate certain insurance products among member states
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Interstate insurance product regulation compact" to regulate certain insurance products among member states and to promote and protect the interest of consumers of individual and group annuity, life insurance, disability income and long-term care insurance products.

sponsored.t: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs
sponsored.sum: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs; defines "pharmacy benefit manager".

sponsored.t: Relates to the oversight of immigration detention facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the oversight of immigration detention facilities; prohibits municipalities from using funds or resources for the construction of any new detention facility or the expansion of any existing detention facility without approval by the legislature; establishes a committee on immigration detention oversight.

sponsored.t: Establishes residential treatment facilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes residential treatment facilities as an alternative to incarceration designated by the commissioner for the care and treatment of persons with serious mental illness who are accused of at least one felony level crime.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rejection by voting machines of ballots that contain a vote for a candidate who previously withdrew from an election
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rejection by voting machines of ballots that contain a vote for a candidate who previously withdrew from an election.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips.

sponsored.t: Requires that the NYS board of regents holds at least two meetings a year in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires that the NYS board of regents hold at least two meetings a year in New York city; requires announcements of the time, date, location and agenda thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the repair or replacement of damaged residential lateral sewer and water pipes
sponsored.sum: Requires public utility companies to repair or replace all damaged residential lateral sewer and water pipes where such damage was caused by such public utility company.

sponsored.t: Requires notice be provided to any officer or employee of the department of corrections and community supervision whose personal information is the subject of a subpoena duces tecum
sponsored.sum: Requires that notice be provided to any officer or employee of the department of corrections and community supervision whose personal information is the subject of a subpoena duces tecum.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of forcible touching of a correction officer and increases criminal penalties for certain sexual offenses committed against correction officers
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of forcible touching of a correction officer; increases criminal penalties for certain sexual offenses committed against correction officers when such correction officer is acting in the course of such correction officer's employment.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of motor vehicles to approve certain out-of-state accident prevention courses
sponsored.sum: Requires the DMV to promulgate rules and regulations to approve certain out-of-state or national accident prevention courses.

sponsored.t: Categorizes members of an auxiliary police program with police officers and peace officers for purposes of certain felony classifications
sponsored.sum: Categorizes members of an auxiliary police program organized and maintained by a state or local police department with police officers and peace officers for purposes of certain felony classifications.

sponsored.t: Delays the start date of the operation and enforcement of the central business district tolling program
sponsored.sum: Changes the start date of the operation and enforcement of the central business district tolling program from no earlier than December thirty-first, two thousand twenty to no earlier than January first, two thousand thirty-one.

sponsored.t: Expands who may visit local correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Expands who may visit local correctional facilities to include persons and accompanying staff of the chief executive officer of a county, members of a county legislative body, mayor of the city of New York, New York city public advocate, New York city comptroller, and members of the New York city council.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding prison work release program eligibility and participation
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding prison work release program eligibility and participation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the investigation of insurance fraud and fines related to the commission of such crime and combatting motor vehicle theft
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the investigation of fraudulent activities with regard to individuals operating motor vehicles without insurance; increases the civil penalty for forging insurance documents; creates the crime of offering a false application for motor vehicle insurance or registration.

sponsored.t: Requires individuals who perform compliance functions, duties or tasks to obtain a compliance officer or compliance practitioner license
sponsored.sum: Requires individuals who perform compliance functions, duties or tasks to obtain a compliance officer or compliance practitioner license; establishes application and examination requirements to obtain, and continuing education requirements to maintain, licensure; permits the superintendent to issue licensing procedures and to prescribe regulations necessary for the proper supervision of compliance officers and practitioners.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities including the causes and consequences of such violence with a particular emphasis on changes in levels of violence and the causes of those changes.

sponsored.t: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services
sponsored.sum: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services.

sponsored.t: Relates to classifying certain property held in cooperative form as class one properties for assessment purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to classifying certain property held in cooperative form as class one properties for assessment purposes.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission relating to local correctional facilities in upstate New York
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission relating to local correctional facilities in upstate New York; provides commission study shall place emphasis on medical and mental health care, overcrowding, incarcerated individual deaths, use of force, restraints, and all segregation and confinement practices and solitary confinement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to downcoding on initial review and audits reversing or altering medical necessity determinations
sponsored.sum: Ensures the decision to downcode an insurance claim is recognized as an adverse determination; prohibits health plans from reversing or altering medical necessity determinations made by a utilization review agent or external appeals agent as a result of an audit of claims.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York title guaranty authority
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York title guaranty authority to initiate and operate a program which shall offer guaranties of real property titles in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to continuing education for licensed persons and qualifications for independent adjusters
sponsored.sum: Relates to claims for loss or damage to real property; creates continuing education requirements for licensed persons and qualifications for public and independent adjusters; allows for a revocation of licenses with an opportunity to reapply for such licenses.

sponsored.t: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists during all school hours and after school activities.

sponsored.t: Requires all police vehicles to be equipped with bulletproof or bullet resistant glass
sponsored.sum: Requires all police vehicles to be equipped with bulletproof or bullet resistant glass on and after January 1, 2027; requires existing police cars to be retrofitted with bulletproof or bullet resistant glass.

sponsored.t: Provides that chiropractors may perform certain services including certifying disability
sponsored.sum: Provides that chiropractors may certify disability for handicapped parking and real property tax purposes and be employed by school districts to assist medical inspectors.

sponsored.t: Requires approval of the salary plan for the chancellors, presidents and senior staffs of the state university of New York and the city university of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires approval of the salary plan for the chancellors, presidents and senior staffs of the state university of New York and the city university of New York by the chairs of the senate finance committee and the assembly ways and means committee and the director of the budget.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of body imaging scanning equipment in local correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of body imaging scanning equipment in local correctional facilities for the screening of visitors and staff in addition to incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of staging a construction site accident
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of staging a construction site accident which is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the certificate of insurance reliability act (CIRA)
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for and forms of certificates of insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer except under exceptional circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to correctional facility visits by the correctional association
sponsored.sum: Relates to correctional facility visits by the correctional association; authorizes the correctional association to visit correctional facilities at any time and without advance notice; grants the correctional association access to certain records and information of correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for increased podiatry care and benefits under accident and health insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Provides for increased podiatry care and benefits under individual and group accident and health insurance policies and contracts within non-profit medical and dental indemnity, or health and hospital service corporations.

sponsored.t: Includes bias-related graffiti in hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Includes bias-related graffiti in hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Enacts provisions to reduce the incidence of motor vehicle insurance fraud and motor vehicle theft
sponsored.sum: Grants the superintendent of financial services authority to investigate fraudulent activities, such as motor vehicle operators who drive with no insurance coverage, and those who misrepresent their principal place of residence or where their motor vehicle is principally garaged and operated; authorizes such superintendent to accept reports of suspected fraudulent insurance actions; requires insurance companies and self-insurers to report incidents of insurance fraud to the department of financial services; includes within the class D felony of forgery in the second degree, the forgery of a certificate of insurance or an insurance identification card; includes within the class C felony of…

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of fire insurance premium taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the distribution of fire insurance premium taxes; provides that a percentage of fire insurance premium taxes be paid to the treasurer of the NYS Professional Firefighters Association to promote, support and maintain the well-being of paid professional firefighters employed in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to intentional physical injuries to a police officer
sponsored.sum: Relates to intentional physical injuries to a police officer due to a belief or perception regarding such police officer's involvement in a previous arrest of such person constituting assault in the first and second degree.

sponsored.t: Requires signs to be posted at gasoline stations for consumers to contact the department of state regarding price or product problems
sponsored.sum: Requires signs to be posted at gasoline stations for consumers to contact the department of state regarding price or product problems.

sponsored.t: Requires gas stations to maintain backup generators for gas pumps
sponsored.sum: Requires gas stations to maintain backup generators capable of operating the gas pumps in the event of loss of electricity.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study examining private flood insurance
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study examining the increasing costs of insurance premiums, the lack of availability of insurance coverage for losses from flooding, and the possibility of supporting a private flood insurance market in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of dentistry
sponsored.sum: Removes references of law related to restoring and maintaining dental health.

sponsored.t: Affords uniformed personnel of the NYC department of correction and NYC department of sanitation the option of taking a monetary payment in lieu of terminal leave
sponsored.sum: Affords uniformed personnel of the NYC department of correction and uniformed members of the NYC department of sanitation the option of taking a monetary payment in lieu of terminal leave at the rate applicable on the date of retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to capping cost sharing for antiviral COVID-19 therapeutics
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies, medical expense indemnity corporations, hospital service corporations, health service corporations and medical assistance programs to provide coverage for prescribed antiviral therapeutics approved by the food and drug administration for the treatment of COVID-19 at no cost to the patient.

sponsored.t: Establishes the construction insurance notification act (CINA)
sponsored.sum: Establishes the construction insurance notification act (CINA) requiring notification of governmental agencies and departments when certain construction insurance policies have lapsed or been canceled.

sponsored.t: Relates to title insurance
sponsored.sum: Permits any title insurance corporation or title insurance agent, or any other person acting for or on behalf of the title insurance corporation or title insurance agent, from undertaking any usual and customary marketing activity aimed at acquainting present and prospective customers with the advantages of using a particular title insurer or title insurance agent that are not intended for the purpose of a reward for the future placement of, or the past placement, of a particular piece of title insurance business; lays out such permitted practices.

sponsored.t: Expands authorization for certain exemptions from filing requirements
sponsored.sum: Expands authorization for certain exemptions from filing requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires a public hearing to be held when land is proposed to be converted for public use
sponsored.sum: Requires that when the state or an organization is attempting to convert land to public use in a municipality with a population of less than one million, a hearing shall be held in such municipality where such land is located to allow for public comment and input from neighbors; requires a ten day notice of such hearing to members of the community.

sponsored.t: Enacts the child custody reform act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of staging a motor vehicle accident in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Provides that anyone who directs, hires, requests, encourages, orchestrates or invites another individual to cause a collision involving a motor vehicle shall be guilty of staging a motor vehicle accident in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 470 of the judiciary law relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to create a family reunion program
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to create a family reunion program to provide eligible incarcerated individuals and their families the opportunity to meet for an extended period of time in a residential setting.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a licensed massage therapist to present a state issued photo identification card when requested
sponsored.sum: Requires a licensed massage therapist to present a state issued photo identification card when requested at the time of performing services.

sponsored.t: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process
sponsored.sum: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process.

sponsored.t: Permits dentists to administer vaccinations against human papillomavirus
sponsored.sum: Permits dentists to administer vaccinations against human papillomavirus.

sponsored.t: Enacts the automobile insurance consumer information act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "automobile insurance consumer information act"; provides for automobile insurance consumer information and complaint ranking; creates office of public insurance consumer advocate and powers and duties therefor; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Permits dentists to administer influenza and COVID vaccinations and vaccinations related to a public health emergency
sponsored.sum: Permits dentists to administer influenza and COVID vaccinations and vaccinations related to a declared public health emergency; requires dentists to report such vaccinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing requirements for bail bond agents
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing requirements for bail bond agents; requires additional course instruction and other prerequisites to licensure.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a marketing program to solicit corporate sponsorships
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a marketing program to solicit corporate sponsorships for naming rights of transit facilities owned by the authority; directs revenues to be placed in the metropolitan transportation authority finance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain
sponsored.sum: Requires financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; makes such crime a class B misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis
sponsored.sum: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis to those that have a disability and who are at serious risk for death, disease or other harm due to an emergency disaster being declared provided such person has a reasonably stable living situation upon release and does not pose an unreasonable current public safety risk.

sponsored.t: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services
sponsored.sum: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the hiring of consultants
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the superintendent of financial services to hire an actuary to assist with reviewing any rate or form filing submitted to the superintendent.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Health Care Nondiscrimination Act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Health Care Nondiscrimination Act; requires insurance coverage and health plans to implement equality and non-discrimination between licensed health care providers; requires fee parity between different classes of licensed providers providing the similar or like-kind services; requires practitioners to discuss and refer or prescribe non-pharmacological treatment alternatives before prescribing an opioid treatment; allows any licensed health care provider to perform certain services, including certifying disability and employment by school districts; provides for enforcement and penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for anesthesia services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for anesthesia services; provides that an insurer may use a time related reimbursement methodology for anesthesia services if such methodology is based upon criteria established by an independent organization.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for child and family treatment and support services and children's home and community based services
sponsored.sum: Requires all policies that provide coverage for inpatient hospital care to include benefits for child and family treatment and support services and children's home and community based services.

sponsored.t: Establishes reporting requirements for out of state entities provide reimbursement of health care costs
sponsored.sum: Establishes reporting requirements for out of state entities provide reimbursement of health care costs and penalties for failing to comply with such reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the conversion of certain real property to cooperative or condominium ownership in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that a plan may not be declared effective for conversion to cooperative or condominium ownership until written purchase agreements have been executed and delivered for at least twenty-five percent of all dwelling units in the building or group of buildings and written consent has been obtained from the bona fide tenants who were in occupancy of fifty-one percent of the dwelling units in the building or group of buildings or development on the date a letter was issued by the attorney general accepting the plan for filing.

sponsored.t: Relates to statewide municipal reciprocal program agreements and the issuance of program bonds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes statewide municipal reciprocal program agreements and the issuance of program bonds; authorizes proceeds to be made available to a statewide municipal reciprocal program.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies and Medicaid to cover patient navigation services
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies and Medicaid to cover patient navigation services.

sponsored.t: Relates to used motor vehicle dealer education
sponsored.sum: Establishes used motor vehicle dealer training programs to educate dealers on topics such as consumer protection and sales and use tax collection; permits trade organizations to apply to conduct training programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements for pharmacy benefit managers
sponsored.sum: Requires certain information to be included in every pharmacy benefit manager's annual report to the superintendent such as the aggregated dollar amount of rebates, fees, price protection payments and any other payments the pharmacy benefit manager received from drug manufacturers through rebate contract, the amount of certain allocations, and information on rebate contracts.

sponsored.t: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services
sponsored.sum: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services.

sponsored.t: Provides for licensure of a massage therapy establishment
sponsored.sum: Establishes the process for a massage therapy establishment to be duly licensed; provides for the application process; sets standards for massage therapy establishments; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Allows for certain participants in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations to be eligible for disability benefits
sponsored.sum: Allows for participants in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations who were not members of a New York state retirement system at the time of such participation but who are now currently active members in such retirement systems to be eligible for disability benefits.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "construction laborer insurance protection act (CLIPA)"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "construction laborer insurance protection act (CLIPA)"; requires every policy or contract of insurance issued to an owner, contractor or subcontractor performing the work of erection, demolition, repairing, altering, painting, or cleaning of a building, structure or edifice to provide coverage for bodily injury and death of workers.

sponsored.t: Relates to general hospital cost reports
sponsored.sum: Requires general hospitals to post publicly copies of their institutional cost reports.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription drug cost-sharing assistance
sponsored.sum: Authorizes insurance policies which provide coverage for prescription drugs where cost-sharing obligations are determined by category of prescription drugs to offer a program to insureds that utilizes rebates or discounts to lower an insured's cost-sharing for prescription drugs if the insured's cost-sharing under such program would be more favorable than the cost-sharing that would otherwise be applicable to the prescription drug.

sponsored.t: Improves transparency in the insurance claims process
sponsored.sum: Improves transparency in the insurance claims process; regulates insurance adjusting professionals; institutes licensing standards for insurance professionals; ensures timely responses to insurance claims; enhances policyholder protections.

sponsored.t: Relates to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property in the city of New York for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2024.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reporting by the office of fire prevention and control
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting of statewide training hours allocated to each firefighter; requires such report shall identify the fire department or district providing the training.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 126 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 3790, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to reporting by the office of fire prevention and control" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Office of Fire Prevention and Control to report the name, department, and hours of training for every firefighter in the State and to report a list of names of qualified interior fire- fighters. I fully support the continued advancement of firefighter training to ensure the safety of all firefighters. I established the volunteer fire- fighter training stipend program in 2023. Since the program's inception, over 2,000 volunteer firefighters have completed and requested stipends for interior firefighter training. The Office of Fire Prevention and Control also provides training to tens of thousands of…

sponsored.t: Requires rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports
sponsored.sum: Requires rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 41 Chapter 660 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7038-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to requiring rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports" APPROVED This bill would require the Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS) and the Office of Mental Health (OMH) to provide commercial insurers with fee schedules that identify the Medicaid rates for certain services. In 2024, I proudly advanced legislation to require commercial insurers to reimburse in-network behavioral health providers at a rate no less than the Medicaid rate for certain outpatient services. I am committed to providing insurers with the information they need to comply with this mandate. However, this bill would require OASAS and OMH to produce…

sponsored.t: Relates to high deductible health plans and health savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Relates to cost sharing requirements for high deductible health plans and health savings accounts.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 19 Chapter 625 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 5367-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to high deductible health plans and health savings accounts" APPROVED This bill provides a general exception to cost-sharing limitations imposed by the Insurance Law for high-deductible health plans that qual- ify for a health savings account, if such cost-sharing limitations would jeopardize the tax-exempt status of the health savings account. I support the goal of this bill. However, as drafted, the bill would only provide protections to health savings accounts until an insured meets the minimum deductible set by the Internal Revenue Service, not the high-deductible health plan's actual deductible. I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to ensure that the protections of the bill apply until the insured meets the actual deduct-…

sponsored.t: Relates to exemptions from real property taxes for senior citizens
sponsored.sum: Authorizes localities to provide for an additional real property tax exemption for senior citizens who meet the income eligibility limits and other criteria to the extent of sixty-five percent of the assessed valuation of such real property.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study pertaining to a proposed expansion of the Long Island Motor Parkway trail
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation and the office of mental health to conduct a study pertaining to a proposed expansion of the Long Island Motor Parkway trail.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 70 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Requires the superintendent of financial services to promulgate regulations which provide standardized definitions for commonly used terms and phrases in certain insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent to promulgate regulations which provide standardized definitions for commonly used terms and phrases in certain insurance policies.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 35 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 1572, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to requiring the superintendent of financial services to promulgate regulations which provide standardized definitions for commonly used terms and phrases in certain insurance policies" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Superintendent of Financial Services to promulgate regulations establishing standardized definitions for common- ly used terms in personal and commercial property/casualty policies and require their use in all such policies issued or delivered in New York. The bill is intended to provide clarity to policyholders, for whom commonly used terms and phrases can have different meanings when used in different policies. While well-intentioned, not all insurance policies are structured…

sponsored.t: Relates to financial loss as a result of a failed in-vitro fertilization or intrauterine insemination
sponsored.sum: Provides for a credit insurance policy for the indemnification of an intended parent for expenses disbursed when either the intended parent or a person acting as surrogate receives in-vitro fertilization or intrauterine insemination treatment that fails and does not result in the birth of a child.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 44 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7321-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to requiring health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering" NOT APPROVED This bill would require commercial health insurance policies that provide medical, major medical, or similar comprehensive-type coverage to cover speech therapy for stuttering with no cost sharing. The bill would prohibit such coverage from being subject to any durational bene- fit limitations. Individual and small group health insurance policies are already required to cover habilitative and rehabilitative speech therapy for all conditions including stuttering. However, such coverage may be subject to cost sharing and durational benefit limitations. As such, the bill would expand coverage in a way that…

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to medical malpractice insurers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to medical malpractice insurers until December 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the exemption from filing requirements only with respect to rates and policy forms to out of state businesses
sponsored.sum: Relates to extending the exemption from filing requirements only with respect to rates and policy forms to businesses underwritten and transacted from an office outside this state.

sponsored.t: Establishes an online insurance verification system for motor vehicle insurance
sponsored.sum: Establishes an online insurance verification system for motor vehicle insurance; requires insurers to provide necessary information.

sponsored.t: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities for fiscal year 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance
sponsored.sum: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance with respect to life insurance agents.

sponsored.t: Requires peer-to-peer car sharing programs provide certain insurance coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires peer-to-peer car sharing programs provide insurance coverage in amounts equal to the financial responsibility requirements set forth in section three hundred eleven of the vehicle and traffic law; removes requirements relating to requiring additional insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice of the posting and modification of a pamphlet on residential mortgage
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice of the posting and modification of a pamphlet on residential mortgages of which such information shall be provided to mortgage bankers and banking organizations.
